# Frontend instructions

Follow `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` and `docs/UX_GUIDELINES.md`.
Mobile and desktop are required. Use semantic HTML, accessible labels/focus, and loading/empty/error states. Never expose server-only env vars. Isolate mock data and remove it when real queries are implemented.
